thread:
Aisha: We need a conservative rollout plan for routing-v2 that satisfies enterprise customers asking for opt-out and clear kill-switches. Can we spell out cohorts, gating windows, and comms?
Noah: Proposal: micro-canaries by tenant tier: (alpha customers 0.5% traffic) -> (beta 2%) -> (general 10%) -> (full). Each step held for 1h stable telemetry + 30m extended quality check.
Ravi: Infra notes: add prewarmed instances and reserve 15% spare capacity. Also add a route-level health probe that measures 5xx and queue depth per shard. If queue depth spikes > 40% above baseline, auto-fallback route to v1 for affected shard.
Aisha: Gate thresholds: absolute 5xx > 0.3% OR p95 latency up > 28% -> pause. For quality we'll run a small eval suite on sampled sessions (n=200) after each ramp and require <1.2% drop in correctness.
Noah: For A/B, keep a control slice 5% and run randomized assignment per session id. Shadow logging for 48h. We'll store quality diffs and flag any failing prompts for human review.
Ravi: Runbook snippet for emergency escape:
```
# tenant-level opt-out
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/override \ 
  -d '{"tenant":"TENANT_ID","flag":"route_v2","value":false}' 
# verify route health
curl https://routing.internal/status?tenant=TENANT_ID
```
ops-bot: deploy: routing-service:v2 canary scheduled 2026-08-05T14:00Z (alpha). Watch #eng-oncall.
CS-Notifications: Reminder: send targeted opt-out instructions 72h before alpha->beta transition to any tenant that has "sensitive-data" tag.
Aisha: Owners: Noah (rollout lead), Ravi (infra & fallback), Aisha (PM & comms), CS owns customer notices. Can we get signoff by EOD tomorrow?
Noah: I'll draft the RFC and add the smoke tests (simulate 10% 5xx for 60s) to CI gating.
Aisha: Great — ensure the playbook includes steps to escalate to SE and create a Loom for CS. Thanks all :raised_hands:
